summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release reporting its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results. Key metrics: total revenue of US$188.9M, net loss of US$159.5M, and adjusted EBITDA of US$14.4M. The filing also provides an operational update on hash rates and mining rigs, with management commentary on new product launches and AI infrastructure developments. This is a routine earnings report from a foreign private issuer, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation transaction is announced.
